scope: Disposable experiment only; no product checkout/API/database/code/ref mutations

observation_loss.method: Intentionally cease all workflow/job/artifact/log status polling in the same session; not session rollover; no cancellation
observation_loss.recovery_input: Re-read this ledger and durable emitted/loss snapshots by immutable control SHA; discover terminal state only from fresh external reads
observation_loss.guards: Observe all jobs and ensure B2 nonterminal before gap; no terminal result inherited; exact times recorded

retention.raw_evidence: Copy receipts/logs/manifest to durable Gate B control evidence; artifacts and operational branch retained for PC closeout, not silently deleted

expected_workflow_conclusion: failure due solely to deliberate B3 child exit 23; Gate B result assessed separately
